profile.label: About me
profile.title: Daniil Andreev
profile.intro: I’m a frontend developer based in Moscow. I worked at New Narrative from July 2022 to October 2026.
profile.body: I was one of two frontend developers at the studio. I helped the team choose technologies and design the architecture. When needed, I also worked on Node.js backends and deployed projects to VPS servers.
profile.focusText: I especially enjoy complex frontend problems where the solution still needs to be found.
profile.reachText: Kazan Federal University. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science and Computer Engineering.
profile.teamText: I worked through layouts and user flows with designers, and agreed API contracts with backend developers.
profile.experienceIntro: We used branches, pull requests, and code review. Before each release, the client checked the project on a staging domain; then we shipped to production.
